Bangla as state language: Sylhet raised the demand first
2023-02-28T21:09:36+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/bangla-state-language-sylhet-raised-the-demand-first-3259691

After the 1947 partition, the demand to make Bangla the state language was first raised in Sylhet. In the 71st year of the Language Movement, watch how Sylhet played its role in the movement in today's Star Special.
